chunks: We have made distinct the examples for the people in this Qur'an from every kind of example, yet most of the people refuse except in unbelief.
ai.seo_question: Why do most people reject the guidance of the Qur'an despite its clear parables?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine strategy of using diverse 'amthal' (parables) to cater to different intellectual levels, yet it underscores the stubbornness of the majority who, despite clear evidence, default to kufr (disbelief) due to spiritual arrogance. This reflects the concept of 'istidraj' or gradual entrapment, where repeated guidance is met with rejection, serving as a precursor to the detailed accounts of previous prophets in the surah. The verse thus establishes the epistemological gap between divine clarity and human obstinacy, a key theme in understanding the Qur'an's rhetorical power.
